settings.label: Backups
settings.description: Keeps earlier note text when you save, rename or delete a note. Backups beside notes are ordinary vault files: public readers can open old or deleted text. Choose a folder outside the vault to keep backups private. Each note path has its own history; changing the backup folder does not move or delete earlier backups.

fields.label: Retained versions
fields.description: The newest backup ends in .0.bak. Lowering this count removes extra versions the next time that note is backed up successfully.

fields.label: Backup base path
fields.description: Leave empty to keep backups beside notes. Relative paths start at the vault; absolute paths choose a directory on the server. Folder names follow the note's original path. Shell shortcuts and environment variables are not expanded.
